full_sentence: Although the phone was expensive, the camera is excellent and the battery lasts all day.
acceptable_variants: the battery lasts all day, so I am happy.

options.text: so I bought two of them.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that contrasts with the first part.

options.text: the store was closed on Sunday.
options.why_wrong: This adds an unrelated fact and does not contrast with the price of the phone.

options.text: I was not hungry at lunch.
options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to the phone, so it does not complete the review.

options.text: the camera is excellent and the battery lasts all day.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows a positive point contrasting with the negative point in the first part. Reviews often use this pattern to describe both the price and the quality of a product.
translation: Aunque el teléfono era caro, la cámara es excelente y la batería dura todo el día.
